FANTASY & PERIOD

STUDY 128
Black Velvet Gown in the Cemetery
Rights check
Source: 25014.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy dark brown
hair walks along a fallen-leaf path between old
headstones. She wears a black lace-trimmed fitted
bodice with covered buttons and a black velvet
floor-length skirt, with a silver belt at the waist. Lace
cuffs hang from her wrists, and a pendant rests at her
throat. Her expression is calm and serious. Soft, filtered
light with blurred trees behind her. Palette of black,
deep burgundy, and muted green. Dramatic and gothic,
in the style of a cinematic period film still.
Dramatic, gothic, romantic
WORKING NOTES
- The lace-trimmed bodice and velvet skirt are the defining
textures.
- Keep the cemetery and leaves for a moody setting.
